problems.symptom: Users could receive 'Не удалось загрузить сайт' before the real page rendered.
problems.root_cause: Production served a browser bootstrap that fetched p0.bin..p4.bin and reconstructed/decompressed the real HTML client-side instead of serving the verified self-contained page directly.
problems.resolution: Production deployment dpl_2k1x8VbTGQtisfTptmeUzfafJane builds and serves the project as direct self-contained HTML. Release/live guards forbid the old loader markers.
problems.verification: Vercel build log: 115467-byte direct self-contained PASS; public kyokushin-nn.vercel.app returned HTTP 200 with x-kyokushin-build=self-contained and real UI markers.

problems.symptom: Merged, green source changes do not publish the exact verified commit to the public Vercel domain.
problems.root_cause: GitHub Actions does not have VERCEL_TOKEN. PR #27 added a bounded diagnostic and CI run 32744059135 printed VERCEL_TOKEN_PRESENT=false without exposing any secret value. The Vercel project is also not Git-linked, so the existing Actions deployment lane is the intended publication path.
problems.mitigation: Source/release CI continues to fail closed for production deployment without credentials; release-aware smoke prevents stale production from being reported as current. Do not replace this with a binary/bootstrap or manual unverified deploy path.
problems.completion_gate: Restore a bounded VERCEL_TOKEN, then a push to project/kyokushin-nn completes verify -> exact-SHA Vercel production deploy -> exact-release public smoke without exposing the credential.

problems.symptom: Headless Chromium screenshot QA hangs in the current container, preventing trustworthy desktop/mobile perceptual acceptance.
problems.root_cause: Repeated tests, including trivial pages and the exact CI artifact, point to the execution container's D-Bus/zygote environment rather than a website runtime defect. WeasyPrint is insufficient because it does not faithfully support the site's modern browser CSS/runtime behavior.
problems.completion_gate: Run responsive visual/runtime QA on a normal browser-capable runner against an exact release and preserve representative desktop/mobile evidence.

problems.symptom: If script.js failed or JavaScript was disabled, the shipped HTML contained an empty #instructorList, hiding the practical 18-hall directory, schedules and direct phone/map actions.
problems.root_cause: Recruitment cards were rendered only on the client even though the same canonical instructor data is available at build time.
problems.resolution: PR #29 makes build-static.mjs prerender the complete 11-instructor / 18-venue directory from the canonical instructors array. JavaScript progressively replaces the fallback when available; health/release/live guards require staticDirectory=true.
problems.verification: GitHub Actions run 32745390974: build staticDirectory=18/11 PASS; release-contract staticDirectory=true PASS; verify-static-directory confirmed 11 instructors / 18 venues before JavaScript enhancement.
problems.completion_gate: Deploy merge b76254091934e3a4d3406f1348692988c5ce9aca or a later verified descendant and pass exact public production smoke.
